subject: maths
question: C alone can complete a work in 50 days and D alone can complete the same work in half of the time taken by C. In how many days will both together complete 3/10 part of the total work?
solution:
**Given:**

C alone can complete a work in 50 days.

D alone can complete the same work in half of the time taken by C.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by both together in 1 day = Work done by C in 1 day + Work done by D in 1 day

**Calculation:**

Work done by C in 1 day = 1/50

Time taken by D to complete the work = 50 / 2 = 25 days
